name: Eugene Ice Cubing 2024
information: # **This is a rescheduled competition, double check the registration requirements** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EugeneCubing2023#17662-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)
